title: Rollback rehearsal calendar and patch bundle guide (Mar 2026) - WIP
content:
Purpose:
Quick operational guide for running regional rollback rehearsals during patch weeks, and a lightweight rulebook for assembling patch bundles that minimize cross-region coupling. This is a working checklist + calendar for the March 2026 patch window.

Scope:
- Applies to: hosted API, Dedicated, Private (VPC) deploys.
- Focus: small/medium patch batches (<=3 microservices), config flips, model-pin updates and quantization profile rolls.
- Not covered here: major schema migrations or DB sharding changes.

High-level goals:
- Verify rollback path end-to-end within 4 hours for a target region.
- Ensure patch bundles contain compatible model variants and fallback policies.
- Practice comms and afternoon handoffs with product, SRE, and CS.

Patch-bundle assembly rules (short):
1) Size cap: bundle <= 3 deploys that touch the same routing plane or model catalog entry.
2) Compatibility matrix: every bundle must list compatible model versions and KV-cache invalidation strategy.
3) Fallback pair: include a pre-approved fallback model (quantized or earlier minor version).
4) Test tag: add CI tag patch-week/rollback-tested before scheduling.
5) Owner: one engineer accountable per bundle + on-call SRE for the window.

Weekend rehearsal calendar (proposed):
- Day 0 (Friday 18:00 UTC): preflight sync (30m) - owners, SRE, product ops, CS. Checklist review. Slack: #release-runway.
- Day 1 (Saturday 10:00 local region): canary deploy (1% traffic), smoke tests 30m, health check gating.
- Day 1 (Saturday 11:00): expand to 10% for 45m if green, run workload replay for 20m.
- Day 1 (Saturday 13:00): simulated fault injected (fail a worker pool) and perform rollback drill. Time target: full rollback within 90m.
- Day 1 (Saturday 16:00 UTC): debrief (30m) - notes captured, telemetry snapshots attached to PR.
- Day 2 (Sunday 09:00 UTC): follow-up fixes and staggered re-run (optional)

Timezone notes: schedule local-region runs in the target region's working hours where possible; prefer starting rehearsal in morning to leave buffer for fixes.

Rehearsal script (operator checklist):
- Preflight (30m before start): verify obs dashboards open, test query to staging model route, verify quota windows, verify KMS access tokens.
- Canary deploy step: push bundle to canary queue, register canary in routing table labeling.
- Smoke probes (automated): 50 synthetic requests across short/long prompts, embeddings check for lat variance, and a multi-turn chat path for memory/KV cache sanity.
- Health gating: error rate < 0.5%, p95 latency within X% of baseline (use hook metrics).
- Fault injection: scale down 20% of replica nodes or simulate a model-serving OOM on a single host.
- Rollback mechanics: initiate model-pin revert -> clear client-side cache TTL if needed -> monitor draining traffic. Document exact API calls in the bundle README.
- Post-rollback validation: run smoke probes again, run a small sample of real traffic from replay logs.

Telemetry and metrics snapshot (what to capture):
- Request/s, token/s, p50/p95/p99 lat, 5xx rate, inference GPU mem pressure, KV cache hit ratio, prefix reuse rate.
- Attach a line chart snapshot and a short CSV with 1m resolution for the window (t-30m .. t+120m).

Communication and stakeholder syncs (short calendar):
- Preflight message -> #release-runway (10m before start).
- Canary success/failed pings -> PagerDuty if > threshold (PD: RELENG_CANARY).
- 1h post-rollback summary -> email to product-ops and CS (template below).
- Afternoon handoff (16:00 UTC): 15m sync with on-call SRE and release owner, confirm follow-ups.

Draft release-notes blurb (to copy into the release PR):
- Summary: small patch bundle that updates model-embedding service to v2.3.1, tightens client-side timeout for streaming endpoints, and refreshes quantization profile for small-gpu variant.
- Risk: Low-medium. Canary window exercised and rollback drill completed in 78m during rehearsal.
- Action for customers: No action required. If you experience increased latency on long chat sessions, please contact support with trace id.

Template: 1h post-rollback summary email (short):
Subject: [Patch-week] <bundle-id> - Rehearsal run summary (region)
Body: TL;DR: Rehearsal executed - rollback completed in HH:MM. Canary expanded to 10% before rollback. Key signals: p95 latency +3% vs baseline, 5xx within expected. Action items: 2 follow-up PRs (RELENG-###, RELENG-###).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Should we automate the fault injection step via our chaos repo? (TODO: Marcus to sketch automation).
- Do we add an explicit model-quality smoke (ROUGE/BLEU) for any model-variant change? Current plan: sampling only. Decision needed.
- Confirm that private deployments will have the same rollback API available (Asha to confirm with private-deployments team).

Linked checks before scheduling a patch window (quick preflight):
- Bundle has fallback pair listed (y/n)
- CI tests: patch-week/rollback-tested tag (y/n)
- Owners and on-call assigned (y/n)
- Notebook: telemetry snapshot link included in PR (y/n)

Notes to self: capture the post-run snapshots and paste into PR description rather than attach — makes the postmortem flow easier. Keep the rehearsal tight: 3h total cap per region.

Appendix: quick command cheats (examples to paste into runbook)
- Rollback model-pin: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/model-pins/revert -d '{"route":"/chat","pin":"v2.3.0"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
- Drain canary: gcloud run services update-traffic my-canary --to-latest-revision=0
- Snapshot telemetry: ./scripts/snapshot-metrics --start "$START" --end "$END" --out ./snapshots/<bundle-id>.csv

End of draft.

(If you pick this up: please add the exact PD escalation playbook and a link to the private-deploy rollback API spec once confirmed.)
